financials.financial_capacity_note: An engagement of €220,000 over 3 years is well within Faber IA's normal deal range and financial capacity.

one_off_project_costs: integration with the firm's production tools
cost_structure.note: Hosting and inference vary with the hosting tier and the model option selected by the technical team.

budget_envelope.cost_efficiency_note: The sovereign tier with the sovereign European model is the most cost-efficient configuration on the recurring side; the premium high-availability tier with top-tier proprietary inference is materially more expensive and is reserved for cases requiring peak resilience or maximum generative performance.
budget_envelope.finance_role: Works with the architect to keep the configuration within the SME envelope while preserving an acceptable margin.

margins_and_commercial_posture.approach: Favours cost-efficient tiers/models that protect the gross margin and the predictability of recurring costs, and arbitrates accordingly where the requirements allow.
margins_and_commercial_posture.cost_model: Maintains a three-year cost model that can be re-run if the requirements or budget change.
